# Cyborg Resilience Co-lab (CRC) · 賽伯格韌性實驗室

> 研究 × 科技 × 藝術的跨域行動平台，探索戰爭、災難與科技風險交疊下的數位韌性。
> A Taiwan-based initiative of civic hackers, digital-rights activists, researchers
> and artists working on digital resilience: subsea cables, off-the-grid
> communication (Meshtastic, Reticulum), and internet-shutdown preparedness.

Primary language is Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) with English secondary.
All content pages are static HTML — no JavaScript required to read them.

## Sections

- [Latest News 最新訊息](https://crcolab.art/news/): announcements and updates
- [Events 活動](https://crcolab.art/events/): forums, hackathons, workshops
- [As Seen on Media 記錄/報導](https://crcolab.art/records/): event records, press coverage, panels, talks
- [Ideas 提點子](https://crcolab.art/ideas/): long-form working papers, essays, and thinking-in-progress
- [Team 團隊](https://crcolab.art/team/): individual member profiles (schema.org Person, machine-readable)

## Featured

- [孤娘的無人機藝](https://crcolab.art/events/2026-10-17-wandering-daughter-ai-for-all/) / [Wandering Daughter’s Warfarring](https://crcolab.art/en/events/2026-10-17-wandering-daughter-ai-for-all/): CRC exhibition, Oct 17–25, 2026, B3, New Taipei City Art Museum; special exhibition for AI for ALL: Opening Act, Taiwan Festival 2026. Installations on drones, anti-surveillance tents, Meshtastic/radio, and computers, framed through the wandering daughters (孤娘) of Taiwanese folk religion.
